newsitem.title: USA: Quickturn stake held by FMR group.
newsitem.headline: Quickturn stake held by FMR group.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp said Tuesday it holds a 7.33 percent stake in Quickturn Design Systems Inc or 1,031,142 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 150,000 common shares bought between December 2, 1996 and February 27, 1997 at prices ranging from $15.67 to $22.13 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.
FMR Corp is the parent to Fidelity Management & Research Co, investment adviser to Fidelity Funds.
Quickturn, based in Mountain View, Calif., is a semiconductor design automation firm.
